title: Compute a Masked Action Flow-Matching Loss
summary: A flow model learns how to move a noisy action toward a demonstration.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Normalized sensor features/actions are dimensionless; embodiment IDs are schema indices, not physical coordinates.

physical_contract.axes: Explicit batch, time, embodiment and channel axes defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Observations are synchronized by the caller; flow time is dimensionless and differs from physical sampling time.
physical_contract.batching: Explicit batch, time, embodiment and channel axes defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Noise-to-data flow matching with an explicit support mask; this captures the GR00T action objective family, not DDPM noise prediction or the complete published training recipe.
